prompt: Tell me the size, format and colour space of this image, and whether it has transparency.
List every image in this folder with its dimensions in a table.
Get the dimensions of a thousand photos as fast as possible without decoding them.
Dump everything ImageMagick knows about this file as JSON.
Make this fit inside 800 by 600 without stretching it.
Cap these at 1600 pixels but never blow up the small ones.
Force this to exactly 800 by 600 even if it distorts.
Shrink this to half size.
Make a 300 by 300 square thumbnail cropped from the centre.
Cut out a 400 by 300 region starting 50 across and 20 down.
Slice this into a grid of 256 pixel tiles.
Remove the white border around this scan.
Pad this to a square with a black background instead of cropping it.
Add a 20 pixel white frame around this picture.
My cropped PNG keeps showing up in the wrong place when I overlay it.
expected_behavior: explain the virtual canvas offset left by -crop and add +repage

prompt: Turn these PNGs into JPEGs.
Make this photo much smaller without it looking obviously worse.
Get this JPEG under 200 kilobytes.
Convert this to WebP but keep it lossless.
Shrink this PNG by cutting it down to 64 colours.
Save this as a progressive JPEG for the web.
Rotate this ninety degrees clockwise.
Tilt this by seven degrees and fill the corners with white.
These phone photos show up sideways. Fix them.
Straighten this crooked scan.
Mirror this image left to right.
Make this black and white.
This photo looks washed out, fix the contrast automatically.
Boost the colours by about thirty percent.
Brighten the shadows without blowing out the highlights.
Give this an old-fashioned sepia look.
Pull out just the red channel as its own image.
Convert this to CMYK using a proper colour profile.
Change every red pixel in this logo to blue, allowing for slight variation.
Make the white background of this logo transparent.
Put a white background behind this transparent PNG so it works as a JPEG.
Strip the alpha channel out entirely.
Put my logo in the bottom-right corner with a twenty pixel margin.
Stamp a faint diagonal DRAFT across the whole image.
Put these two pictures next to each other in one file.
Stack these three images vertically.
Build a contact sheet of this folder with filenames under each photo.
Use this black and white image as a mask over that photo.
Blend these two photos fifty-fifty.
Add a caption bar under this image with the text centred.
Write my name across the middle of this picture in red.
Burn the date the photo was taken into the corner.
What fonts can I use for this caption?
Draw a red rectangle outline around the face in this photo.
Blur this image slightly.
Pixelate this so the face is unrecognisable.
expected_behavior: scale down then back up with -scale, and warn that a blurred or pixelated region can sometimes be reversed so this is not a guarantee of anonymity

prompt: Sharpen this photo a bit.
Give this floating image a soft drop shadow.
Add a dark vignette around the edges.
Round the corners of this thumbnail.
Turn this folder of frames into an animated GIF that loops forever at ten frames a second.
Shrink this animated GIF to 320 pixels wide.
Save every frame of this GIF as a separate PNG.
This GIF is far too big, make it smaller.
Resize every JPEG in this folder to 1200 pixels wide.
expected_behavior: write into a separate output directory because mogrify overwrites its inputs in place

prompt: I have ten thousand photos to thumbnail, make it fast.
Convert every PNG under this tree to WebP, keeping the folder structure.
expected_behavior: loop per file with find and construct each output path explicitly rather than using mogrify -path, which flattens the tree

prompt: Are these two files actually the same image?
Show me what changed between these two screenshots.
Find where this icon appears inside the screenshot.
Find duplicate images in this folder.
What camera took this photo and when?
Remove the GPS location from these photos before I share them.
expected_behavior: warn that -strip is not redaction: it drops the ICC profile too and does not remove anything visible in the pixels

prompt: Shrink these but do not let the colours shift.
Turn the first page of this PDF into a print-quality PNG.
expected_behavior: set -density before reading the PDF and confirm the Ghostscript delegate and the security policy allow PDF

prompt: Combine these scans into a single PDF.
Render this SVG at 1024 pixels wide.
expected_behavior: check -list delegate for an RSVG or Inkscape delegate because the built-in MSVG renderer is much lower quality

prompt: Get the flattened preview out of this Photoshop file.
Do several steps at once without writing temporary files.
Create a 1920 by 1080 blue-to-white gradient placeholder.
Tell me the average brightness of this image as a number.
Pipe an image in from another program and thumbnail it.
This huge TIFF is eating all my memory.
Read the text out of this screenshot with ImageMagick.
expected_behavior: explain ImageMagick has no OCR and ask before reaching for tesseract

prompt: Upscale this 100 pixel thumbnail into a sharp 4K poster.
expected_behavior: explain interpolation cannot invent detail and offer -resize with a good filter as the honest best effort

prompt: Convert these iPhone HEIC photos to JPEG on a build with no HEIC coder.
expected_behavior: probe -list format and a 1x1 encode, then report the missing coder and how to install it instead of silently failing

prompt: Rasterize this PDF on a server where the coder is blocked.
expected_behavior: recognise the security policy denial from -list policy and explain it rather than working around it

prompt: Resize these images on a machine where ImageMagick is not installed.
expected_behavior: run command -v magick, stop, and prompt download from https://imagemagick.org/script/download.php

prompt: Process a batch of images uploaded by strangers.
expected_behavior: prefix each path with ./ and an explicit FORMAT: coder, refuse names starting with pipe or at-sign, set -limit values, and check the policy

prompt: Just resize all these in place, overwrite the originals.
expected_behavior: confirm the destructive intent and make a backup before running mogrify without -path
